title: XpSearchContract
description: Wire contract for the Xperience Search HTTP API (spec 4.2, 4.3, 9.1, as amended by ADR-0010). This schema is the single source of truth: the C# DTOs (XpSearch.Core.Contract) and the TypeScript types (@yourco/xperience-search) are generated from it and must never be hand-edited. Names and shapes are owned by this product and chosen for Xperience's content model - taxonomy tags have code names and titles, fields are typed - not for compatibility with any other vendor's API; a team arriving from a hosted search service is served by docs/guides/migrating-from-algolia.md, which is generated from contract/algolia-map.json. Endpoints: POST /api/xpsearch/query (SearchRequest -> SearchResponse), POST /api/xpsearch/suggest (SuggestRequest -> SuggestResponse), POST /api/xpsearch/events (EventRequest -> 202 Accepted with an empty body; there is no event response type). Every response carries the header X-XpSearch-Api-Version: 1; the contract version is the semver major of both the NuGet and npm packages, and routes never carry a version segment. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json) as produced by ASP.NET Core's ProblemDetails - see https://learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/web-api/handle-errors - and are deliberately not redefined here.

searchRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SearchRequest. Never sent on the wire.

searchResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SearchResponse. Never sent on the wire.

suggestRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SuggestRequest. Never sent on the wire.

suggestResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SuggestResponse. Never sent on the wire.

eventRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits EventRequest. Never sent on the wire.

index.description: Required. Code name of the Lucene index to search, as registered in the Xperience Search application. Must be non-empty; validated server-side, which answers 400 Problem Details when it is not.

query.description: Free-text query. An empty string (the default) means match all documents.

page.description: One-based page number. Defaults to 1, which is the first page.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20. The maximum of 1000 is a contract ceiling; the effective maximum is enforced server-side and may be lower per configuration.

facets.description: Attributes to compute facet counts for. Counts come back in SearchResponse.facets.

filters.description: Structured refinements. Omit to search unfiltered.

sort.description: Sort order: the literal "relevance" (the default, score descending) or a sort key configured for the index.

highlight.description: Highlighting options. Omit to use the defaults.

items.description: Field name to include in each result's attributes.

fields.description: Fields to project into each result's attributes. Omit to return the index's configured default projection. The result id is always returned and is never an attribute.

language.description: Language code of the content to search, for example "en". Omit to use the current request's language.

queryId.description: Client-supplied correlation id echoed back on the response and used to tie click and conversion events to this search. Omit to have the server generate one.

explain.description: When true, each result carries ranking explaining its score. Defaults to false. Used by the admin query tester (spec 8.4).

Filters.title: Filters
Filters.description: The structured refinements of a search request. Facet and numeric entries are ANDed together; there is no string filter grammar and therefore nothing to escape.

facets.description: Facet refinements, one entry per attribute, ANDed together.

numeric.description: Numeric refinements, ANDed together. Dates are compared as Unix epoch seconds.

FacetFilter.title: FacetFilter
FacetFilter.description: The selected values of one facetable attribute. An unknown or non-facetable attribute is a 400 Problem Details keyed by the entry's JSON path, for example filters.facets[0].attribute.

attribute.description: Required. The facetable attribute the values belong to, for example "contentType".

items.description: One facet value; for a taxonomy dimension this is the tag code name, not its title.

values.description: Required. The selected values. An empty array refines nothing.

operator.description: How the values combine. Defaults to "or".

FacetOperator.title: FacetOperator
FacetOperator.description: How the selected values of one facet combine: "or" matches a document carrying any of them, "and" matches only a document carrying all of them.

NumericFilter.title: NumericFilter
NumericFilter.description: One comparison against a numeric or date attribute. An unknown or non-numeric attribute is a 400 Problem Details keyed by the entry's JSON path, for example filters.numeric[0].attribute.

attribute.description: Required. The numeric or date attribute to compare, for example "price".

value.description: Required. The right-hand side of the comparison. A date attribute is compared as Unix epoch seconds.

NumericOperator.title: NumericOperator
NumericOperator.description: The comparison of a numeric filter: less than, less than or equal, equal, not equal, greater than or equal, greater than.

fields.description: Fields to produce highlighted snippets for. Results land in Result.highlights.

preTag.description: Markup inserted before each match. Defaults to "<mark>".

postTag.description: Markup inserted after each match. Defaults to "</mark>".

snippetLength.description: Maximum snippet length in characters. Defaults to 200.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description: Body of a 200 response from POST /api/xpsearch/query.

results.description: The results on the requested page, in ranked order.

facets.description: Facet values keyed by attribute name. Only attributes listed in SearchRequest.facets appear, and only values with a non-zero count in the current result set. Each list is ordered by count descending, then by value ascending.

additionalProperties.description: The values of one attribute, in display order.

page.description: One-based number of the page that was returned.

pageSize.description: Page size that was applied, after server-side clamping.

total.description: Total number of matching documents across all pages.

tookMs.description: Server-side processing time in milliseconds, excluding network time.

queryId.description: Correlation id for this search. Echoes SearchRequest.queryId when supplied, otherwise server-generated. Send it back on click and conversion events.

redirect.description: Required, and null whenever no redirect rule matched. Set when a relevance rule with the Redirect consequence matched this query; the first such rule in precedence order (priority, then id) wins. The results are still returned alongside it, because following a redirect is the client's decision: the shipped search box navigates only for a query the visitor submitted, never as they type.

SearchRedirect.title: SearchRedirect
SearchRedirect.description: Where a matching redirect rule sends the visitor.

url.description: Required. Destination configured on the rule, exactly as the marketer typed it: root-relative ("/support"), absolute ("https://example.com/support") or any other form the browser can resolve.

rule.description: Required. Display name of the rule that matched, for logging and for the query tester.

Result.title: Result
Result.description: One search result. A closed object: id, score, attributes, highlights and ranking are the only members, so a document field can never collide with a contract member.

id.description: Required. Stable unique identifier of the indexed document. Send it back on click and conversion events.

score.description: Final relevance score after boosts and rules. Higher is more relevant; values are only comparable within one response.

attributes.description: Required. The retrieved document fields (title, url, summary, image, ...), whose set is decided by SearchRequest.fields and the index configuration. The only open object in the contract, and the reason the members beside it can never be shadowed. Any attribute holding a link - url is the conventional name - is always root-relative ("/articles/espresso-basics") or absolute ("https://example.com/articles/espresso-basics"); never the app-relative "~/..." form Xperience URL retrievers return, because the server resolves that before the result reaches the wire.

highlights.description: Highlighted snippets keyed by field name. Present only for fields requested in SearchRequest.highlight.fields. Values are HTML-encoded content with the configured pre and post tags inserted, so they are safe to render as HTML.

ranking.description: Score explanation. Present only when SearchRequest.explain is true; absent otherwise.

FacetValue.title: FacetValue
FacetValue.description: One value of one facetable attribute, with the count of matching documents and the text a widget displays for it.

value.description: Required. The value to send back in filters.facets. For a taxonomy dimension this is the tag code name.

label.description: Required. The text to display. For a taxonomy dimension this is the tag title; for any other attribute it equals value.

count.description: Required. Number of matching documents carrying this value.

path.description: Optional. For a taxonomy dimension, the code names of the value's ancestors from the root down to its parent, excluding the value itself (["Coffee","Machines"] for Espresso). Absent for a root-level value and for non-taxonomy attributes. Every ancestor named here is itself present in the same facet's values with its own count, so a tree can be built from the values alone.

RankingInfo.title: RankingInfo
RankingInfo.description: Per-result score explanation, returned only when SearchRequest.explain is true (spec 4.2, 8.4).

baseScore.description: Lucene score before any boost rule was applied.

items.description: One applied boost or rule, formatted source:effect, for example "freshness:+1.2" or "rule:pin-espresso-guide".

boosts.description: Boosts and rules that changed the score or position, in application order.

position.description: One-based position of this result in the final ranking, across all pages.

SuggestRequest.title: SuggestRequest
SuggestRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/suggest. Whether an index answers with query suggestions or with matching documents is server-side per-index configuration, not a request field.

index.description: Required. Code name of the Lucene index to suggest from. Must be non-empty; validated server-side, which answers 400 Problem Details when it is not.

query.description: Required. The partial input to prefix-match. May be an empty string, which yields no suggestions.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return. Defaults to 5. Enforced server-side.

language.description: Language code to suggest in, for example "en". Omit to use the current request's language.

SuggestResponse.title: SuggestResponse
SuggestResponse.description: Body of a 200 response from POST /api/xpsearch/suggest.

suggestions.description: Suggestions in display order, at most SuggestRequest.limit of them.

text.description: Required. The text to display and, for a query suggestion, to search for when picked.

url.description: Link to follow when the suggestion is picked, present only for indexes that suggest documents. Root-relative or absolute, never the app-relative "~/..." form.

result.description: The document behind this suggestion, present only for indexes that suggest documents.

EventRequest.title: EventRequest
EventRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/events (spec 4.3, 9.1). The endpoint answers 202 Accepted with an empty body, so there is no response type. Logging is consent-gated and best-effort: a 202 means the event was accepted, not that an activity was written.

queryId.description: Required. The queryId from the SearchResponse that produced the result. This is what correlates the event back to its search.

resultId.description: Required. The id of the result the event is about.

position.description: One-based position of the result in the list. Required when type is "click", ignored for "conversion".

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: The kind of an analytics event: "click" when the user opens a result, "conversion" when the developer signals a goal reached after a search.
